approaches.strongest_proved_result: Proved homogeneous nilpotent-correction acyclicity criterion for finite polynomial–exterior DGAs; separately proved sign-only characteristic-2 criterion.
approaches.remaining_gap: Only zero-object recognition is decided. General pairwise equivalence is not reduced to it.

approaches.strongest_proved_result: Proved exact correspondence between integer roots and augmentations, giving augmentation-existence undecidability via DPRM.
approaches.remaining_gap: No fixed-pair equivalence gadget recovers existence of a root; root existence does not imply equivalence to the base ring.

approaches.strongest_proved_result: Proved quasi-isomorphism of regular Koszul models iff quotient-ring isomorphism; exhibited nonregular syzygy obstruction.
approaches.remaining_gap: Needed undecidability theorem for complete-intersection ring isomorphism is unavailable; arbitrary presentations introduce higher homology.

approaches.family: Finite map spaces and tame certificates
approaches.strongest_proved_result: Proved strict-isomorphism decidability in positive degrees over finite fields and positive semidecidability of stable tame equivalence.
approaches.remaining_gap: No recursive certificate bound or complete negative semidecision for general equivalence.

approaches.strongest_proved_result: Computed all homology and a nonzero Massey product for A_n; classified this family up to quasi-isomorphism and rational stable tame equivalence.
approaches.remaining_gap: No general derivation classification or undecidability reduction; derived Morita classification not proved.
